# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v4 c1 P22](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0022)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel Colby is a striking, dark-eyed girl who was referred to as the "rose-red" girl. She was awarded the beauty prize among Second Year classes during her time at Regent's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Mabel possesses a heart filled with yearning, light, and multicolored dreams and imaginations, while also maintaining a quiet, placid demeanor. She is prone to occasional moments of despondency and pessimistic humor. Additionally, she has a habit of tossing every page of her manuscript to the floor while writing.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c16 P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 c35 P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031), [v3 c36 P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), [v3 c38 P16](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0016)_

## Traits

- imaginative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- dreamy  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- placid  <sub>[v3 c38 P16](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0016)</sub>

## History

While studying at Regent's Academy, Mabel became close friends with Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis, earning the beauty prize among Second Year students. Following her schooling, she worked continuously as a schoolteacher. Years later, she joined Nell, Honora, and Cressida Lindsay in renting Tabby's Place in Wexcombe for their university studies, bringing her Aunt Euphemia to handle housekeeping. During her time residing at Tabby's Place, Mabel took charge of the household financial records and contributed to the Philomathic Society. Upon finishing her studies at Wexcombe, she moved to Vancouver to work as a teacher.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c10 P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 c17 P1](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0001), [v3 c36 P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v4 c1 P22](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0022)_
